criterion.c6_is_linear: space_residual is the sine of the largest principal angle (tests/test_projection_convention.py:277), so R_C6(1) IS the relative first-order symmetry-breaking amplitude of the first SR update -- there is no square root
criterion.c6_is_not_an_order_parameter: v = 0 (the filled LLL) is invariant under every rotation, so the liquid reads ~3e-14: a low C6 is also the liquid
criterion.energy_resolution: 14 snapshots/step, naive SEM, autocorrelation ignored and consecutive rows sharing the walker -> E_err is a LOWER bound; E is descriptive here and never decisive
criterion.force_is_jastrow_dominated: d ln Psi/dc is O(10)-O(40) while d ln Psi/dv is O(1e-3) (sr_pilot_scale's docstring), so |f| -> 0 means the JASTROW converged; ||dv|| is the orbital-block answer
criterion.stage_a: is the CLOSING state still a crystal (bragg ratio against the liquid measured in the same run, and real-space contrast)?  If not, its C6 residual names nothing.
criterion.stage_b: the shape of the C6 trajectory.  SEED_NOT_C6 is checked first; STILL_RISING / PLATEAU_BROKEN / REGISTRY_DRIFT name the next experiment rather than an answer about (a)-(d).

force_floor.note: the seed-to-seed scatter of |f| at t = 0, where every arm starts from the same theta0

layer1_verdict.reason: the seed IS C6-covariant here: 3.032e-14 at r_s = 90, n_max = 1 (the pinned corner is r_s = 75, n_max = 2, so this is measured rather than inherited); the conjugated-overlap control reads 5.944e-01 -- a separation of 2.0e+13; a second context agrees to the same order; the residual is invariant under a column rescaling to 3.3e-18

protocol.seed_index_rule: raw = base_rng_seed + index, so index 0 IS the production reference for this budget
protocol.tau_schedule: tau_i = tau / (1 + xi i / steps); at i = 0 this is tau for EVERY steps, which is why R_C6(1) is comparable across budgets and step counts while R_C6(t>1) is not
